meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证并规划本地基因组间隔工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理基因组数据并需要验证BED文件
copy.tagline_en: Validate and plan local genomic-interval workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic data and need to validate BED files

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能处理基因组区间数据（BED 文件）的机器学习任务，包括训练区域嵌入（Region2Vec）、单细胞 ATAC-seq 分析（scEmbed）和构建共识峰集（universes）。
howto.when: 当你提供 BED 文件、提到 scATAC-seq 数据或要求做基因组区域机器学习分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Region2Vec 训练这些 BED 文件的区域嵌入
对这份 scATAC-seq 数据做细胞聚类
从这些 BED 文件构建共识峰集
say.note: 会生成 universe 作为后续分析的参考峰集。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude handle machine learning tasks on genomic interval data from BED files, including training region embeddings (Region2Vec), single-cell ATAC-seq analysis (scEmbed), and building consensus peak sets (universes).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide BED files, mention scATAC-seq data, or request ML analysis of genomic regions.

say_en.text: Help me train Region2Vec embeddings on these BED files
say_en.note: It will tokenize the BED files and then train the model.

say_en.text: Cluster the cells in this scATAC-seq data
say_en.note: It will generate cell embeddings with scEmbed and cluster with scanpy.

say_en.text: Build a consensus peak set from these BED files
say_en.note: It will create a universe as a reference for downstream analysis.
